description: Versioned schema for the engine CSS property catalog. Every row is checked against internal/layout handler discovery and the pinned upstream inventory by scripts/css-catalog-map.py. Selected motion rows also record behavior tests in OwnFrame.

statuses.implemented: A handler exists, a consumer outside the style layer reads the value, and at least one resolvable behavior test covers the property. tests must be non-empty. Motion rows scoped to blinkless+ownframe also require downstream_tests in OwnFrame.
statuses.partial: A handler and a consumer exist, but at least one named behavior is missing or unverified in implementation_scope. limitations names the gap; tests may be empty.
statuses.unsupported: No consumer and no observable behavior. The declaration may be parsed and stored or dropped entirely; either way it degrades gracefully. limitations names the missing behavior.
statuses.intentionally ignored: The engine deliberately ignores the property (print-noop UI chrome or similar). limitations names the reason.

row_fields.name: Canonical property name, lowercase, optional vendor prefix (for example display or -webkit-line-clamp).
row_fields.aliases: Alternate names the dispatcher folds onto this property (vendor aliases from normalizeVendorPrefix plus direct legacy case-arm aliases).
row_fields.values: Value forms the engine is recorded as accepting. Non-empty for implemented and partial rows. Seeded from the pinned upstream syntax where present; CAT-05 audits each form against its handler.
row_fields.upstream_syntax: Optional verbatim value syntax from the pinned upstream inventory for cross-checking. Not an engine claim by itself.
row_fields.upstream_class: Optional provenance class from the pinned inventory: draft, vendor, svg, or browser-ui.
row_fields.limitations: Named missing or unverified behaviors. Non-empty for partial, unsupported, and intentionally ignored rows.
row_fields.implementation_scope: For CSS motion rows, blinkless-only means Blinkless exports metadata without runtime sampling; blinkless+ownframe means the downstream OwnFrame sampler is covered by tests.
row_fields.source: Repo-relative code paths that contain the handler, or the pinned upstream file for rows with no handler. Every path must exist.
row_fields.handlers: Informational list of discovered handler functions for this property. Checked only for existence, not for status promotion.
row_fields.tests: Behavior-test references as {file, name}. Each file must define func name. Non-empty for implemented rows.
row_fields.downstream_tests: For blinkless+ownframe rows, OwnFrame test references as {file, name, case_file, case}; paths are relative to the OwnFrame checkout, and the named case must be present in case_file.
row_fields.status: One of the status keys above.

summary_fields.by_status: Row count per status; recomputed and compared on every check.
summary_fields.engine_registered: Rows whose name or an alias has a discovered handler.
summary_fields.upstream_only: Rows with no discovered handler (pinned upstream properties, unsupported or intentionally ignored).
summary_fields.upstream: Pin reference: inventory name, revision, property count, cataloged count, and class counts. cataloged must equal properties for the check to pass.

enforced: handler not cataloged (a discovered handler name has no row or alias)
missing handler for an implemented or partial row
missing or unresolvable source and behavior-test references
missing or malformed scope and downstream-test evidence for CSS motion rows
rows neither in the pinned upstream inventory nor a discovered handler
checks.promotion_rule: Handler presence never promotes a status. Status changes are catalog edits with evidence, reviewed like code.
